annotations.title: Compare a 401(k) loan with a hardship withdrawal, personal loan and HELOC

description: Prices four ways to raise the same cash with the 401k.loans comparison tool: 401(k) loan, hardship withdrawal (grossed up for tax and the 10% additional tax), personal loan (rate plus origination fee) and HELOC. For each: amount taken out, monthly payment, money gone for good (interest to others, fees, tax, penalty), interest paid back to yourself, how much smaller the 401(k) is at term end and at 65, and whether it is allowed.

assumed_return_pct.description: Annual return you assume the 401(k) would earn, in percent (-20 to 20). An assumption, not a forecast. Default 6.

cash_needed.description: Cash you need in hand, in dollars, e.g. 10000.

federal_bracket_pct.description: 2026 federal income tax bracket in percent (Rev. Proc. 2025-32): 10, 12, 22, 24, 32, 35 or 37.

heloc_closing_costs.description: HELOC closing costs in dollars. Default 0.

heloc_rate_pct.description: HELOC rate in percent, 0 to 20. Default: the prime rate alone, before the margin a lender adds.

origination_fee_pct.description: Personal loan origination fee in percent of the loan, 0 to 12. Default 0.

penalty_exception.description: true if an exception to the 10% early withdrawal tax applies (for example, you left this employer in or after the year you turned 55). The 10% is never applied at 59.5 or older. Default false.

personal_loan_rate_pct.description: Personal loan interest rate in percent (not the APR), 0 to 36. Default 11.9, the Federal Reserve G.19 average on 24-month bank loans (Q3 2026).

plan_loan_fee.description: Flat 401(k) loan fee in dollars. Default 0.

plan_rate_pct.description: 401(k) plan loan rate in percent, 0 to 20. Default: the prime rate plus 1 point, as an example.

state_tax_pct.description: State income tax rate in percent, 0 to 15. Default 0.

years.description: Years to pay back, 1 to 5. Default 3.

name: compare_401k_loan_alternatives
title: Compare a 401(k) loan with a hardship withdrawal, personal loan and HELOC
